_comment: Chapter 6 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): the mirror whole (mirror_shards 3): Liora's truth (the Star, the old god, the "Master"); c6.mirror: the quest done; trust + 1.

text.zh_TW: 三片碎鏡在你手裡拼成一面完整的小鏡子。莉歐拉的臉清清楚楚地出現了。「終於……我能好好跟你說話了。」
text.en: The three shards fit together in your hand into one small, whole mirror. Liora's face appears, clear at last. "At last... I can really talk to you."

text.zh_TW: 莉歐拉：「塔頂的安穩之星，是用來關住一個古老的神的。那個神想要一具神裔的身體——你的身體。沃卡司封印了星星，把它擋在外面。而我……我是星星的鑰匙。只有我能重新點亮它。」
text.en: Liora: "The Star of Peace at the top of the tower is there to keep an old god out. That god wants a Godborn body: yours. Vorkath sealed the Star to hold it back. And I... I am the Star's key. Only I can light it again."

text.zh_TW: 莉歐拉：「就是那個神的聲音，從星星的裂縫裡漏出來的。它騙了收集者，騙了布蘭。里歐——不管它對你說什麼，都不要讓它進來。答應我。」
text.en: Liora: "It is that god's voice, leaking through the crack in the Star. It deceived the Collectors. It deceived Bran. Leo, whatever it tells you, don't let it in. Promise me."
